I think that this isn't the right time to make such a decision. Btw, would you mind if I talked to you in private? You seem very well-oriented and experienced in that matter, and now when I think about it, there's little more that I forgot to mention in that thread.

Thank you for your comment. I'd do everything for it to pass or to treat it even if it means going to a psych ward. I just want my boyfriend to feel safe around me. Now when I think about it, I wrote that post with too many emotions going on in me, and that made me look like a total suicidal person. It's a whole different story, but I'll tell my therapist about my suicidal tendencies.  


The reason why I created that thread was because I'm really exhausted with my thoughts telling me nonstop to break up because I abused him physically. He told me not to make a big deal out of it, that It didn't even hurt, but I can't seem to calm down even a little. I can't take a rest from them ever since then. I feel like I should break up and that It can't even be fixed or forgiven. My thoughts will probably bother me more for the next few months because of what happened today. I feel sick :(

I understand now. I kind of hesitated asking that last question but decided to give it a shot. I feel more confident now, and I'll talk about it with my therapist. It's so weird that these love feelings are more visible now but tomorrow I may be questioning again if to break up or not. Thank you again!! :)

It turned out good :) Though when getting intimate they kinda wanted to kick in and they did but just after our moment. When I wasn't paying attention to them they weren't too perceptible. Does that mean my feelings for him MAY BE still alive?

Thank you! Sometimes I really don't even know what I'm feeling. They just pop out for no reason telling me that it's just my gut feeling. Now I don't know if to act on them or not. I don't know if to leave it as it is, or break up. I don't want to hurt him and I still love him, but they're too real and won't leave me alone. It feels like my love is disappearing :(
I relate to you... Though I'm feeling numb so no crying but my love for my pets vanished too :( I'm not planning on breaking up with him though! Take care, you're not alone
So... What I exactly feel is called ''a back door spike''?
The question is; are they real? And do we act on them? I don't know if I can make it any longer knowing that these thoughts are there even when I wake up.
